tool_calls.arguments:
{"path":"gateway-manifest.yaml","content":"apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: app-gateway
  namespace: default
spec:
  gatewayClassName: traefik
  listeners:
    - name: http
      port: 8000
      protocol: HTTP
---
apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: HTTPRoute
metadata:
  name: app-route
  namespace: default
spec:
  parentRefs:
    - name: app-gateway
  hostnames:
    - app.example.com
  rules:
    - matches:
        - path:
            type: PathPrefix
            value: /app
      backendRefs:
        - name: app
          port: 80
"}
